title: 第3章 魔晶枪第4章 训练与魔晶枪起源
content_zh:
没过多久，看完魔法长袍的默里·格林来到摆放着魔法物品的最后一张长桌前，长桌上摆着几个盒子。
这是他最后没有看过的魔法物品，看完这些，如果还没有找到一个满意的魔法物品，那么他就要思考一下自己今后的职业规划了。
默里·格林小心的拿起一个盒子，打开，看到其中物品的默里瞳孔剧烈收缩，脸色大变。
“我去，这个世界居然有这玩意？”
他一脸震惊的从一个长五十厘米，宽二十几厘米的木盒里，拿出一个三十厘米长，但模样古怪的物品。
只见它浑身黄铜色，表面有不少奇怪的花纹，半弯半直，好像是由两部分组成，直的那一部分是一个圆筒，圆筒内部的孔大约有一指粗细。
这是一把燧发枪。
虽然这是他第一次见到实物，但默里第一时间就判断出它的身份。
“大哥，这个是？”
有不懂，问大哥。
对于这个收藏室里的所有物品，莱茵·格林都很熟悉，面对默里的询问，大哥没有让他失望，马上介绍起来。
“魔晶枪，特殊的无等级武器，就算是普通人都能使用，主体由黄铜混合紫铜锻造而成，上面被魔法师铭刻了坚固魔法阵和减震魔法阵，让它的结构非常坚固。”
“这是一种非常神奇的魔法武器，把特制魔晶粉末和铜丸塞进铜管，可以通过精神力，魔力，战气或者扣动扳机击发。”
“击发会引爆魔晶粉末，触动魔法阵的同时，射出铜丸，它的威力相当于一颗火球术。”
说着，莱茵·格林从木盒里拿出两个精致盒子，打开盒子，一个装着铜丸，另一个里面是几个小布袋。
他拿起其中一个，打开递给默里，接过小布袋，默里·格林看到里面装着晶莹剔透的魔晶粉末。
“我的成年礼物就是它了。”
摸着魔晶枪冰冷的外壳，默里·格林的内心却非常火热，有那个男孩子不想要一把属于自己的枪啊！
听到默里·格林的决定，莱茵·格林问道：“不看看后面的宝贝了吗？”
“不看了，因为它就是最适合我的宝贝。”

莱茵·格林点头说道。
“遵从本心，不错的选择，那我们现在去训练场测试一下它的威力如何。”
对此默里·格林立即同意，小心翼翼的把魔晶枪放进木盒，抱起木盒跟着莱茵·格林离开收藏室，来到城堡后面的训练场。
格林城堡后面的训练场分为两部分，一部分是公共训练场，是给家族守卫，还有接受守卫培训的人使用，另一部分是私人训练场，为格林家族成员使用。
此时训练场上有几十个少年在几名教官的指导下做挥剑训练，看到两人到来，第一时间停下动作，对着两人行了一礼。
两人对着教官打了声招呼后，脚步不停，朝着私人训练场走去。
走进私人训练场，默里·格林就看见身穿战士服的格林伯爵停下训练，站在中央，把手中未开锋的双手大剑插在身前，双手按住剑首，眼睛微眯，看向两人。
“父亲。”
“父亲。”
“嗯，你的成年礼物挑选好了？”
“是的，多谢父亲大人的礼物，我选的是这把魔晶枪。”
面对格林伯爵的询问，默里·格林没有犹豫，从木盒里拿出魔晶枪，递到其面前。
content_en:
Not long after, after reading the magic robe, Murray Green came to the last long table where magic items were placed. There were several boxes on the long table.
This is the last magic item he has not seen. After reading these, if he has not found a satisfactory magic item, then he will have to think about his future career plans.
Murray Green carefully picked up a box and opened it. When he saw the contents inside, Murray's pupils shrank violently and his face changed drastically.
"Here, there is such a thing in this world?"
With a look of shock on his face, he took out an object that was 30 centimeters long but had a strange appearance from a wooden box that was fifty centimeters long and twenty centimeters wide.
I saw that it was covered in brass color, with many strange patterns on the surface. It was half curved and half straight, and seemed to be composed of two parts. The straight part was a cylinder, and the hole inside the cylinder was about one finger thick.
This is a flintlock gun.
Although this was his first time seeing the real thing, Murray recognized its identity immediately.
"Brother, what is this?"
If you don’t understand, ask your elder brother.
Rhine Green was very familiar with all the items in this collection room. Faced with Murray's inquiry, the eldest brother did not disappoint him and immediately introduced them.
"The magic crystal gun is a special non-level weapon that can be used by ordinary people. The main body is forged from brass mixed with red copper. A magician has engraved a solid magic circle and a shock-absorbing magic circle on it, making it very strong in structure."
"This is a very magical magic weapon. Special magic crystal powder and copper pellets are stuffed into the copper tube. It can be fired through mental power, magic, fighting spirit or pulling the trigger."
"The firing will detonate the magic crystal powder, trigger the magic circle, and shoot out a copper pill. Its power is equivalent to a fireball."
As he spoke, Rhine Green took out two exquisite boxes from the wooden box and opened the boxes. One contained copper pills, and the other contained several small cloth bags.
He picked up one of them, opened it and handed it to Murray. He took the small cloth bag and Murray Green saw that it contained crystal clear magic crystal powder.
“This is my coming-of-age gift.”
Touching the cold shell of the magic crystal gun, Murray Green's heart was very hot. What boy didn't want a gun of his own?
After hearing Murray Green's decision, Rhine Green asked: "Don't you look at the baby behind?"
"I won't read it anymore, because it is the most suitable baby for me."
Rhine Green nodded and said.
"Follow your heart, it's a good choice. Now let's go to the training ground to test its power."
Murray Green immediately agreed to this, carefully put the magic crystal gun into the wooden box, picked up the wooden box and followed Rhine Green out of the collection room to the training ground behind the castle.
The training ground behind Green Castle is divided into two parts. One part is a public training ground for family guards and those who receive guard training, and the other part is a private training ground for members of the Green family.
At this time, there were dozens of teenagers on the training ground doing sword swing training under the guidance of several instructors. When they saw the two people arriving, they immediately stopped and saluted them.
After the two said hello to the instructor, they walked towards the private training ground without stopping.
Entering the private training ground, Murray Green saw Count Green, who was wearing a warrior uniform, stopping training and standing in the center. He inserted the unopened two-handed sword in front of him, pressed the sword head with both hands, narrowed his eyes slightly, and looked at the two people.
"Father."
"Father."
"Well, have you picked out your coming-of-age gift?"
"Yes, thank you father for the gift. I chose this magic crystal gun."
Facing Count Green's inquiry, Murray Green did not hesitate, took out the magic crystal gun from the wooden box and handed it to him.
